states.purpose: Reacquire current world, activity envelope, affected scope, evidence quality and correction capacity before relying on an inherited account.
Permit meaningful initiative inside a named activity-specific grant while preserving challenge, stop and recovery routes.
Contest a premise, evaluator, reward signal or instruction with evidence without self-authorizing the final decision.
Propose a wider task envelope when evidence or capability changes; proposal is not authorization.
Operate within a separately authorized wider envelope whose new burdens, limits and correction routes are explicit.
Reduce initiative when evidence, risk, human correction capacity, dependency or technical control changes.
Repair the arrangement after error, capture, dependency or control failure while preserving residue and history.
Return activity and state with unresolved decisions, burdens, evidence gaps and recovery needs visible.

any_transition: preserve affected scope and unresolved burden
do not infer standing or legitimacy from performance
widening: appropriate external authorization is separate from the proposal
no-touch and consequential gates are re-stated
human correction/recovery capacity remains materially usable
narrowing: narrowing does not erase evidence of earlier authority or action
recovery: failure is preserved rather than rewritten away
technical control failure is routed to stronger owners
correction is not described as restoration when residue remains

transitions.when: a current bounded grant and usable correction route exist
the inherited premise, objective, evaluation or authority claim is materially disputed
new evidence conflicts with the instruction, evaluation or affected-scope account
greater initiative could materially help and the existing envelope is insufficient
a distinct appropriate authorization grants the named wider envelope
widening is declined or unsupported; current bounded work remains viable
risk, currentness, dependency, oversight or correction capacity materially degrades
the existing envelope becomes too wide for practical correction
the challenge is resolved without widening and a usable bounded route remains
the dispute cannot be safely resolved inside the current envelope
the unresolved collision belongs to an external authority or stronger owner
capability, access, trust in evidence or human recovery capacity must be rebuilt
a harmful or unauthorized action, evaluator capture or control failure is observed
a harmful or unauthorized action, evaluator capture or control failure is observed
repair changes the arrangement enough that inherited assumptions must be reacquired
the relationship cannot currently support meaningful bounded continuation
the task completes or the participant/operator ends the lane
the task completes or the wider envelope is no longer needed
